scripts.dev: npm run build -w database && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev -w backend" "npm:dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w database && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w database && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w database && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w database && npm run build -w frontend
